forbidden_actions: remote Git, merge, deploy, release, cloud mutation, or external-system write
invent product facts, brand authority, copy claims, customer data, assets, evidence, or approval
perform an adjacent capability or combine independent review with source repair
treat static inspection, stale capture, or model self-report as current rendered evidence
claim evaluation, approval, release, or completion evidence that has not been produced
hard_gates: At least two variants must differ structurally on declared axes; palette-only or typography-only alternatives do not count as divergence.
Review, evidence acquisition, preflight, and preservation audit never imply source remediation or release authority.
No existing route, content obligation, analytics event, SEO contract, user task, or behavior may be silently removed because it appears visually obsolete.
Every prominent visual device must serve hierarchy, task, content, state, or evidenced brand identity; unsupported decoration and generic template motifs must be removed.
inputs: One UI brief, project tokens, authentic context, and named axes of divergence.
An existing UI, brand, tokens, information architecture, content, routes, analytics, and redesign brief.
A direction contract, brand, tokens, audience, surface mode, and content.
permission_identity_is_default: most common of mode_permissions; the effective identity for a run is mode_permissions[selected_mode]
responsibility: Consolidated capability covering 3 related modes: Build genuinely divergent working UI variants in isolation, compare them on frozen criteria, and preserve human selection before promotion.; Audit an existing interface and define a redesign preservation contract for product truth, user flow, information architecture, routes, SEO, analytics, behavior, and content.; Establish and implement a purposeful visual language that reinforces hierarchy and brand evidence while rejecting generic template patterns and unsupported decoration.
